unit: one row per (condition, leg): the volume-weighted price Ferrari paid for that leg across the whole condition, and that leg payout at settlement. This is a PRICE-LEVEL calibration, not a decision-time model: the vwap averages fills across the condition life and no row is a quote at an instant.
sample: 1 in 3 RESOLVED conditions by hashtext, all legs of each
encoding: each row is [condition_index, leg_outcome_index, vwap_x10000, qty_x100, fills, payout_x10000, first_ts_minus_t0, last_ts_minus_t0, resolved_at_minus_t0]. Times in seconds.
